kypExtensions.summary: The layer-triage model (opportunist pattern → T-cell zone; everything-recurrent → combined zone; delivery/fusion/burst signatures → phagocyte zone) plus the molecular-thread organization (the X-linked quartet IL-2Rγ/CD40L/WAS/oxidase; the cytoskeleton thread WAS-LAD; the DNA-sentinel thread ATM-AIRE; the signaling thread naming each missing lineage) and the management bridge (HSCT, prophylaxis, IFN-γ, live-vaccine avoidance).
kypExtensions.rationale: The source lists eleven diseases without the zone triage, the thread organization, or the management map; these integrations are KYP's design. Management specifics are labeled extension.
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea + both mechanism captions + callout + patterns + mnemonics + miniCase
